messages.text: England in losing habit after 'failing to adapt' in Perth drubbing

metadata.summary: England "weren't quick enough to adapt to the conditions" as they slumped to a seven-wicket loss to Australia in the first ODI of their three-match series in Perth, according to head coach Brendon McCullum.
metadata.content: Australia vs England: Brendon McCullum blames side's 'failure to adapt' in heavy first ODI defeat in Perth | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Australia vs England: Brendon McCullum blames side's 'failure to adapt' in heavy first ODI defeat in Perth England bowled out for 131 in 33.4 overs as part of seven-wicket drubbing by Australia in first ODI of three-match series at Optus Stadium; second match takes place in Adelaide on Sunday before concluding in Hobart, Wednesday - start times 3.30am, UK time Friday 13 November 2026 13:06, UK Image: Tom Banton trudges off after being dismissed by Xavier Bartlett as England were bowled out for 131 in Perth England "weren't quick enough to adapt to the conditions" as they slumped to a seven-wicket loss to Australia in the first ODI of their three-match series in Perth, according to head coach Brendon McCullum. Unlike their inadequate preparations for the Ashes Test tour last winter - which also started with a heavy defeat at the Optus Stadium - the tourists this time played a proper warm-up game at the comparably bouncey WACA in Perth, but despite the time spent acclimatising, they were bundled out for a mere 131 in 33.4 overs in the series opener. "It all happened pretty quick!" McCullum told TNT Sports after his side's heavy defeat, Australia knocking off the runs in 23.3 overs. "We weren't quick enough to adapt to the conditions. messages.text: Man Utd appoint Pochettino as head coach

metadata.summary: Mauricio Pochettino has been appointed as the new Manchester United head coach, following the sacking of Michael Carrick.
metadata.content: Mauricio Pochettino appointed as Manchester United head coach after Michael Carrick's sacking at Old Trafford | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Mauricio Pochettino appointed as Manchester United head coach after Michael Carrick's sacking at Old Trafford Mauricio Pochettino has been appointed as new Man Utd head coach; the former Tottenham, Chelsea and Paris St-Germain boss will oversee his final two games as USA manager before heading to Manchester; United sacked Michael Carrick with club in Premier League relegation zone Friday 13 November 2026 14:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports News reporter Rob Dorsett reveals the inside details of Manchester United's pursuit of USA head coach Mauricio Pochettino. Mauricio Pochettino has been appointed as the new Manchester United head coach, following the sacking of Michael Carrick. Pochettino will begin the role on Wednesday, after taking charge of the USA's fixtures against Haiti, having signed a deal signed until the summer of 2029. He is set to meet his new players and take training for the first time on Thursday and his first match in charge will be against Liverpool at Anfield on Sunday November 22, live on Sky Sports. Sky Sports News understands United have to pay around £7.4m to buy Pochettino out of his newly-signed contract with the USA.
